description: This file defines the AWS KinesisAnalyticsV2Client class, which extends AwsClient and provides methods to interact with the Amazon Kinesis Analytics service. It includes method annotations for various operations supported by the service, such as creating, deleting, describing applications, and managing resources.

classes.name: KinesisAnalyticsV2Client
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the Amazon Kinesis Analytics V2 service, providing various operation methods.

methods.name: addApplicationCloudWatchLoggingOption
methods.description: Adds a CloudWatch logging option to an application.

methods.name: addApplicationInput
methods.description: Adds an input to an existing application.

methods.name: addApplicationInputProcessingConfiguration
methods.description: Adds a processing configuration to an input.

methods.name: addApplicationOutput
methods.description: Adds an output configuration for an application.

methods.name: addApplicationReferenceDataSource
methods.description: Adds a reference data source to an application.

methods.name: addApplicationVpcConfiguration
methods.description: Adds a VPC configuration to an application.

methods.name: createApplication
methods.description: Creates a new Kinesis Analytics application.

methods.name: createApplicationPresignedUrl
methods.description: Creates a presigned URL for an application.

methods.name: createApplicationSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of an application.

methods.name: deleteApplication
methods.description: Deletes a specified application.

methods.name: deleteApplicationCloudWatchLoggingOption
methods.description: Removes a CloudWatch logging option from an application.

methods.name: deleteApplicationInputProcessingConfiguration
methods.description: Deletes an input processing configuration.

methods.name: deleteApplicationOutput
methods.description: Deletes an application's output configuration.

methods.name: deleteApplicationReferenceDataSource
methods.description: Deletes a reference data source.

methods.name: deleteApplicationSnapshot
methods.description: Deletes a snapshot of an application.

methods.name: deleteApplicationVpcConfiguration
methods.description: Removes a VPC configuration.

methods.name: describeApplication
methods.description: Retrieves details of an application.

methods.name: describeApplicationOperation
methods.description: Describes a particular application operation.

methods.name: describeApplicationSnapshot
methods.description: Provides details about a specific application snapshot.

methods.name: describeApplicationVersion
methods.description: Describes a specific version of an application.

methods.name: discoverInputSchema
methods.description: Discovers the schema of an input.

methods.name: listApplicationOperations
methods.description: Lists operations for an application.

methods.name: listApplicationSnapshots
methods.description: Lists snapshots of applications.

methods.name: listApplicationVersions
methods.description: Lists all versions of an application.

methods.name: listApplications
methods.description: Lists all applications.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: rollbackApplication
methods.description: Rolls back an application to a previous version.

methods.name: startApplication
methods.description: Starts an application.

methods.name: stopApplication
methods.description: Stops an application.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Adds tags to a resource.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: updateApplication
methods.description: Updates an existing application.

methods.name: updateApplicationMaintenanceConfiguration
methods.description: Updates maintenance configuration for an application.
